messages:
Jordan: Follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on the reliability incident. Dropping owners, links, and next steps here so nothing falls through the cracks.
Priya: Can someone paste the RCA and a short mitigation ETA? The product questions during Q&A need answers.
Sam: Draft RCA: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-03-22-draft. Root cause summary: cache invalidation race + router retry amplification. Adding traces and timeline this afternoon.
Anika: I'll take immediate mitigation: add hot-key rate-limits and a router retry guard. Plan: patch by Thu EOD, canary Fri 09:00, wide rollout Mon 02:00 UTC.
Marcus: Please prioritize Dedicated/Private tenants for mitigations and manual runbooks. That's critical for SLA commitments.
Jordan: Confirmed. Execs want Dedicated/Private first. I'll own customer escalations and the leadership blurb.
Lina: I'll draft customer-facing messages for Dedicated/Private and general status updates; will share for review before send.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03122 updated to MONITORING by Sam. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03122
Sam: Debug snippet we used: ```promql
sum(rate(http_request_errors_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (region)
```
Anika: Small note: the patch exposed a flaky integration test; isolating it now so canary signal is clean.
Priya: I'll run a 30m SLO sync Wed 10am with eng-sre, platform, and product. Deliverable: SLO recommendation doc (95th vs 99th latency tradeoffs + rollout plan).
Marcus: I can add a dashboard card for hot-key retry spikes if eng-telemetry signs off.
Sam: Will update the RCA with owners and target close date once canary verification is complete (target next Tue).
Jordan: Owners recap: Anika (mitigation), Sam (RCA & postmortem edits), Priya (SLO sync), Jordan (exec/customer comms), Lina (customer templates), Marcus (dashboard). Reply here to add others. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
